```{r setup}
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
r <- readRDS(file.path(
  if (file.exists("cache/results.rds")) "." else "validation", "cache", "results.rds"
))
m <- r$meta
# categorical slots 1-3 of the reference palette (fixed order)
side_col <- c(
  "archival, exact lookup" = "#2a78d6",
  "archival, unmodified" = "#eb6834",
  "fastMILC" = "#1baf7a"
)
theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), legend.position = "top"))
fmt <- function(x, d = 4) formatC(x, format = "f", digits = d)
count_verdicts <- function(d) {
  d[, .N, by = verdict][order(match(verdict, c("equivalent", "inconclusive", "different", "descriptive")))]
}
```

Run of `r format(m$date, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")`, fastMILC commit `r m$fastMILC_commit`,
nhppp `r m$nhppp`, `r m$R`. End-to-end population N = `r format(m$N, big.mark = ",")`
from `synthetic_nlst_recipe`; seed `r m$seed`. Reproduce with
`Rscript validation/run.R `r format(m$N, scientific = FALSE)`` and
`quarto render validation/report.qmd`.

## Design

**Configuration.** fastMILC runs with `milc.max_age = 110` and the archival
other-cause tail. In this configuration every fastMILC component specifies the
archival model; the remaining differences are numerical (Section *Known
differences*).

**Estimand.** fastMILC simulates people conditional on being alive and without
a diagnosed lung cancer at study entry. The archival `nat_hist` draws are
redrawn per person until `T_do >= entry` and `T_diagn >= entry`. Other-cause
death is independent of the onset–progression–lung-death chain, so this is
the same conditional law, and both sides keep the recipe composition.

**References.**

- *A. Mortality components.* The archival samplers `tdeath_other` and
  `tdeath_lung` do not sample their own tables exactly (Section *Archival
  mortality samplers*). fastMILC is therefore tested against the exact law of
  each archival table: the tabulated CIF at the knots plus, for other causes,
  the archival tail (residual mass $1 - F_{\max}$ spread as
  $\mathrm{Unif}(0,\ 110 - a - h)$ in time since entry $a$), and for lung
  cancer the residual point mass at the horizon $h$ with the $t = 0$ atom
  merged into the first cell (decision R3). Statistic:
  $\max_k |\hat F(t_k) - F(t_k)|$ over knots $t_k > 0$.
  `r format(m$n_fast_stratum, big.mark = ",")` fastMILC draws per stratum,
  at the stratum's mid-group age.
- *Onset and progression components.* fastMILC versus the archival `t_mal` and
  `t_prog` (these samplers are exact up to `uniroot` tolerance).
- *B. End to end (test).* fastMILC `Population` versus the archival
  `nat_hist` in which only the cell lookup of `tdeath_other` and
  `tdeath_lung` is replaced by an exact inverse of the tabulated CIF (linear
  between knots, i.e. the archival uniform within a cell). Everything else is
  the archival code: `nat_hist`, `t_mal`, `t_prog`, age and intensity
  grouping, stratum `grep`, the other-cause tail, the residual lung point mass.
  The replacement is independent of the fastMILC code.
- *C. End to end (descriptive).* fastMILC versus the unmodified archival
  `nat_hist`; draws with an `NA` death time are redrawn and counted.

**Criterion.** Effect sizes: sup-norm distance between distribution
functions (cumulative incidence functions where events compete; all histories
are complete, so there is no censoring) with tolerance 0.005, and absolute
differences of proportions with tolerance 0.005. Each estimate has an
approximate 95% Monte Carlo bound $b$ (Kolmogorov: $1.358\sqrt{1/n_1 + 1/n_2}$,
one-sample $1.358/\sqrt n$; proportions: $1.96\,\mathrm{se}$). Verdicts:
*equivalent* if $|\hat\delta| + b \le$ tol, *different* if
$|\hat\delta| - b >$ tol, *inconclusive* otherwise. Bounds are per row, not
adjusted for multiplicity.

## Summary

```{r summary}
summ <- rbind(
  r$mortality[role == "test", .(part = "A. mortality strata (fastMILC vs exact table law)", verdict)],
  r$components[, .(part = "onset and progression components", verdict)],
  r$end_to_end[oracle == "exact lookup", .(part = "B. end to end vs archival, exact lookup", verdict)]
)
tab <- dcast(summ[, .N, by = .(part, verdict)], part ~ verdict, value.var = "N", fill = 0)
setcolorder(tab, intersect(c("part", "equivalent", "inconclusive", "different"), names(tab)))
kable(tab)
```

## A. Mortality strata

```{r mort-table}
mt <- r$mortality[role == "test"]
kable(count_verdicts(mt), caption = "fastMILC against the exact law of each archival table.")
worst <- mt[order(-estimate)][1:10, .(check, group, n, estimate = fmt(estimate), bound = fmt(bound), verdict)]
kable(worst, caption = "Ten largest distances (fastMILC).")
```

```{r mort-fig, fig.height = 4.2, fig.width = 8}
md <- r$mortality[, .(
  family = paste(check, sub(" .*", "", group)),
  sampler = fifelse(sampler == "fastMILC", "fastMILC", "archival, unmodified"),
  estimate
)]
ggplot(md, aes(estimate, family, colour = sampler)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.005, linetype = 2, colour = "grey45") +
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(height = 0.15, seed = 1), size = 2.2, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_colour_manual(values = side_col, name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "max over knots |F_hat - F_table| (log scale; dashed: tolerance 0.005)",
       y = NULL, title = "Distance from the exact table law, one point per stratum")
```

### Archival mortality samplers

```{r arch-mort}
am <- r$mortality[role == "descriptive"]
fam <- am[, .(
  strata = .N,
  median_distance = fmt(median(estimate), 3),
  max_distance = fmt(max(estimate), 3),
  strata_with_NA = sum(na_rate > 0),
  max_NA_rate = fmt(max(na_rate), 4)
), by = .(family = paste(check, sub(" .*", "", group)))]
kable(fam, caption = "Unmodified archival samplers against the exact law of their own tables.")
```

The archival lookup `which(unique(abs(u1 - est)) == min(...))` takes positions
in the de-duplicated vector of distances and uses them as positions in
`unique(time)`. The step tables store each step twice, so the selected cell
is one to two cells after the cell whose CIF brackets `u1` (decision D8: not
reproduced). The lag matters where the CIF rises steeply over the first cells
(distant-stage lung death) or moves in coarse steps (current-smoker strata
built from few people). When the nearest tabulated value is the last one, the
upper index runs past the table and `tdeath_other` returns `NA`; `nat_hist`
then returns an all-`NA` history. In stratum `>85 female 21+` (three knots)
a quarter of the draws are `NA`.

## Onset and progression components

```{r components}
kable(r$components[, .(check, group, n_fast, n_arch,
                       fastMILC = fmt(value_fast), archival = fmt(value_arch),
                       estimate = fmt(estimate), bound = fmt(bound), verdict)])
```

## B. End to end, archival with exact lookup

```{r e2e-test}
eb <- r$end_to_end[oracle == "exact lookup"]
kable(count_verdicts(eb))
kable(eb[group == "all", .(check, fastMILC = fmt(value_fast), archival = fmt(value_arch),
                           estimate = fmt(estimate), bound = fmt(bound), verdict)],
      caption = "Whole population.")
nonequiv <- eb[verdict != "equivalent"]
```

Rows not judged equivalent (`r nrow(nonequiv)` of `r nrow(eb)`):

```{r e2e-nonequiv}
kable(nonequiv[order(verdict, -abs(estimate)), .(check, group, n_fast, n_arch,
  fastMILC = fmt(value_fast), archival = fmt(value_arch),
  estimate = fmt(estimate), bound = fmt(bound), verdict)])
```

```{r cif-diff, fig.height = 6, fig.width = 8}
cv <- r$curves
w <- dcast(cv, group + event + time ~ side, value.var = "cif")
dd <- rbind(
  w[, .(group, event, time, oracle = "archival, exact lookup", diff = fastMILC - `archival, exact lookup`)],
  w[, .(group, event, time, oracle = "archival, unmodified", diff = fastMILC - `archival, unmodified`)]
)
dd[, event := factor(event, c("diagnosis", "lung_cancer", "other_causes"),
                     c("lung-cancer diagnosis", "lung-cancer death", "other-cause death"))]
ggplot(dd, aes(time, diff, colour = oracle)) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = -0.005, ymax = 0.005,
           fill = "grey85", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey45") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) +
  facet_grid(event ~ group) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-0.008, 0.008)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = side_col, name = "fastMILC minus") +
  labs(x = "years since study entry", y = "difference in cumulative incidence",
       title = "Cumulative incidence, fastMILC minus archival (grey band: tolerance)")
```

## C. End to end, unmodified archival (descriptive)

```{r e2e-desc}
ec <- r$end_to_end[oracle == "unmodified"]
kable(ec[group == "all", .(check, fastMILC = fmt(value_fast), archival = fmt(value_arch),
                           difference = fmt(estimate), bound = fmt(bound))],
      caption = "Whole population; differences include the D8 lookup lag.")
```

## Entry condition and archival NA draws

```{r acceptance}
kable(r$acceptance[, .(oracle, sex, status, n,
  mean_tries = fmt(mean_tries, 3),
  redrawn_for_entry = fmt(share_redrawn_entry, 4),

```

## Known differences

1. **Lookup lag and `NA` draws of the archival mortality samplers (D8).** Not
   reproduced; quantified in Sections A and C.
2. **Shape within a table cell.** fastMILC uses a constant hazard in each
   cell (exponential within the cell); the archival samplers draw uniformly
   within the cell. The two agree at every knot.
3. **Lung atom at $t = 0$ (R3).** Merged into the first cell in fastMILC and in
   the exact-lookup oracle.
4. **Maximum age.** This validation uses `milc.max_age = 110`; the fastMILC
   default is 100 (model.tex, Section 2). Archival onset beyond 110 (search to
   150) is not observable because everyone is dead by 110.
